title: Create CUJ state harnesses for Vaporize spawn and modification proof
createdBy: codex after operator corrected the abstraction to CUJ state

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-06-26: operator corrected that the milestone is just CUJ state and an evolved workstream for vaporware spawn and modification.
historicalContent.description: Vaporize needs a CUJ-state harness that turns critical user journeys into reusable state for vaporware spawn and modification proof. CUJs are the canonical source records: each CUJ defines an actor, intent, preconditions, actions, outcomes, tags, and metadata. Kura-org remains optional storehouse-family context, but the active abstraction and board milestone are CUJ state.

implementedFirstSlice.vaporizeReceipt: vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh test --package-path private/universal/substrate/collectives/wrkstrm-core/private/apple/spm/vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli --configuration debug -- --filter VaporizeCUJ21CUJStateTests passed 3 tests

acceptanceCriteria: Shared test support can derive CUJ state records from CUJs.
Each CUJ-derived state record preserves actor, intent, preconditions, actions, outcomes, tags, and metadata.
Fixture preparation writes cujs.json, cuj-state.json, and cuj-state.receipt.json.
The receipt identifies stateFamily as cuj-state and sourceKind as critical-user-journey.
Kura-org may appear as storehouseFamily metadata, but Kura world is not the milestone abstraction.
The active CUJ21 proof does not expose Turso, libSQL, databaseURL, database-engine, or kura-world language.
knownSeparations: This slice produces CUJ state documents for simulation; it is not a production Kura service adapter.
Kura/Vaults Org owns the storehouse and data-engine family. Vaporize owns the proof harness and receipt lane.
Database engines are implementation details behind future Kura integration, not the board-facing abstraction.
